intent: The composable right-rail shell. Renders the PanelSection children it is given, in order.
use_when: Building an inspector by composing sections.
You want to reorder, add, remove, or replace a section by changing children.
dont_use_when: You want the capability-driven default panel — use PropertyPanel.

header: optional fixed zone above the scroll area (e.g. zoom + Design/Animate tabs)

a11y.sections: each PanelSection can opt into a region landmark.
a11y.scroll: overlay scrollbar — hides with no layout shift; only the selected content is in the reading order.
